trans-unit.target: 塔路易教堂部隊及其盟友的小型營地，由伊德林斯的親臨維繫。

trans-unit.source: A single wagon inhabited by a trained healer who can help against basic ailments.
trans-unit.target: 一輛由受過訓練的治療師居住的馬車，可以幫助治療基本疾病。

trans-unit.source: A quartermaster organising weapon and armor procurment as well as payment of salaries.
trans-unit.target: 軍需官負責組織武器和盔甲的採購以及發放薪酬。

trans-unit.source: A single wagon of a common goods trader, who sees benefits in following an army.
trans-unit.target: 一輛普通商品商人的馬車，他認為跟隨軍隊有利可圖。

trans-unit.source: A camp of Thaluian Chapel forces and their allies, held together by their hate of chaos and Idrinth's own presence.
trans-unit.target: 塔路易教堂部隊及其盟友的營地，因對混沌的仇恨和伊德林斯的親臨而維繫在一起。

trans-unit.source: A group of wagons of a master healer and their apprentices, able to deal with most ailments.
trans-unit.target: 一群大師治療師和他們學徒的馬車，能夠處理大多數疾病。

trans-unit.source: A small council of camp functionaries helping to organise the camp both in civilian and military matters.
trans-unit.target: 一個小型營地職能人員議會，幫助在民政和軍事方面組織營地。

trans-unit.source: Multiple wagons of merchants, who help finance the army as well as make a nice profit on the side themselves.
trans-unit.target: 多輛商人馬車，幫助資助軍隊，同時自己也獲得可觀的利潤。

trans-unit.source: A large camp of Thaluian Chapel forces and their allies, held together by their hate of chaos, opportunism and Idrinth's own presence.
trans-unit.target: 塔路易教堂部隊及其盟友的大型營地，因對混沌的仇恨、機會主義和伊德林斯的親臨而維繫在一起。

trans-unit.source: A group of wagons containing multiple master healers who train students together and heal those in need.
trans-unit.target: 一群馬車，容納多位共同培訓學生並治療需要幫助者的大師治療師。

trans-unit.source: A council of the camp's functionaries led by Idrinth that rules the camp through officials and judgements.
trans-unit.target: 由伊德林斯領導的營地職能人員議會，通過官員和裁決治理營地。

trans-unit.source: An organised guild of merchants, that use the camp as their home base, bringing elven goods to a wide variety of people and benefitting financially.
trans-unit.target: 一個有組織的商人公會，以營地為基地，向各種人出售精靈商品並從中獲益。

trans-unit.source: A small worshop producing elven crafts, allowing the chapel to generate trade and income.
trans-unit.target: 一個小型工坊，生產精靈工藝品，讓教堂能夠產生貿易和收入。

trans-unit.source: A large worshop producing elven crafts and magic items, allowing the chapel to generate trade and income.
trans-unit.target: 一個大型工坊，生產精靈工藝品和魔法物品，讓教堂能夠產生貿易和收入。

trans-unit.source: A small tavern, that allows both chapel forces as well as allies to rest from long days.
